title: Device status
description: The reported state of one device, as its own Kubernetes resource since v1.23.0.

name.description: Resource name, from the object metadata; it matches the device it is the status of.

spec.description: Declared and empty: nothing is desired of a status resource.

twins.description: One entry per property: what was read, and what was asked for.

property-name.description: Property this twin is about, as named on the device model. Wire key: propertyName.

reported.description: What the mapper last read from the device.

observed-desired.description: The desired value the mapper has actually seen, which may lag the one on the device resource. Wire key: observedDesired.

state.description: Reachability state of the device, as reported by its mapper.

last-online-time.description: When the device was last seen, as characters rather than a typed timestamp. Wire key: lastOnlineTime.

extensions.description: Free map written by mapper-side logic, the anomaly-detection framework included. No key is defined by the resource.
